Will customers know they're talking to AI?

Yes. It introduces itself as an AI assistant, which some US states require and which builds trust. Customers can ask for a person at any time, and it passes over the conversation with a short summary so nobody has to repeat themselves.

For most small businesses, $40–$300 a month in AI usage, paid directly to OpenAI, Anthropic or Google, plus phone minutes if it answers calls. We show you a cost estimate based on your real volume before we build anything.

No. We use business API plans whose terms say your data isn't used for training. Conversations are stored in your own accounts, card numbers are never seen by the AI, and access is limited by role.
What happens when it gets something wrong?

Every conversation is logged, so you can see exactly what it said and why. Fixes usually take minutes, like updating a price or adding a rule. Anything involving money, like refunds or discounts, needs a person's approval unless you decide otherwise.
Can it speak Spanish and other languages?
Yes. It replies in the customer's language, including Spanish, Arabic, Vietnamese and Chinese, using the same approved information. Summaries for your team are always written in English.

No, if the move is done properly. We map every old URL to its new page with 301 redirects, keep your titles and descriptions, and watch rankings for 30 days after launch.

You do, 100%. The store is on your Shopify account, the theme code is yours, and so is every customer and order.

qa: Will you just rewrite everything?

Can I keep using Lovable, Bolt or Cursor afterwards?

We sign an NDA first, then you give us read-only access to GitHub, your database and Stripe. We work on a copy, never on your live app, until you approve each change. Nothing is ever shared or reused.
Do I pay before I know what's wrong?
No. The audit is free and takes about 48 hours. It comes with a fixed price for the fixes. If you'd rather fix things yourself with the report, that's fine too.
My app already has paying users. Will they notice?
Only that things stop breaking. Fixes go to a staging copy first, then live at a quiet hour, with a one-click way back. Database changes are tested on a copy of your real data beforehand.
Who owns the code afterwards?
You do. The code, database, hosting and every key end up in accounts in your name. We document how it all fits together, so you, the AI or any developer can keep building on it.

qa: Can you fix my current site instead of rebuilding it?

Often, yes. We start with an audit. If the site is solid underneath, we clean up plugins, fix speed and security, and leave the design alone. If fixing would cost more than rebuilding, we'll show you the numbers and let you decide.
My site was built with Elementor or Divi. Can you work with that?
Yes. We can maintain and speed up a page-builder site. When you're ready to move to a custom theme, we rebuild page by page and keep every URL, so your rankings and links keep working.
Will my team really be able to edit it?

Yes. Everything is built from blocks with clear fields: hours, prices, team members, reviews. You get a recorded walkthrough and a one-page cheat sheet. Most teams make their first change on launch day.
Our site was hacked. Can you clean it up?

Yes, usually within 24 hours. We remove the malware, close the hole it came in through, reset access and get Google to drop any warning. Then we put the site on a care plan so it doesn't happen again.
Where will the site be hosted?
On managed WordPress hosting such as WP Engine, Kinsta or SiteGround, in your own account. Expect AED 75–220 a month for most business sites. We set it up and handle the move.
Who owns the site, the theme and the plugins?
You do, 100%. The hosting account, the domain, the theme code, every custom plugin and all of your content are yours. No lock-in and no licence fees to us.
Can the site be in Arabic?
Yes. We build right-to-left Arabic and English into the same theme, with a language switcher, from the Starter tier up.
